about_the_game:
Sizzle & Stack is a unique blend of restaurant management and card-based strategy, inspired by Stacklands. Build your dream kitchen, manage ingredients, and craft delicious meals by stacking cards in creative ways. Balance resource management, time pressure, and customer satisfaction as you progress through increasingly challenging days. Unlock new recipes, upgrade your kitchen, and earn prestige from demanding gourmet critics.

Stack, Cook, and Serve!

In Sizzle & Stack, every dish starts with the right ingredients—stack them correctly, use the right tools, and create mouthwatering meals for your customers. But watch out! Inventory space is limited, and managing your resources efficiently is key to keeping your restaurant running smoothly.

Master the Art of Cooking

  • Stack Ingredients & Cook Recipes – Combine the right cards to prepare dishes.

  • Serve a Variety of Customers – Regular diners, picky reviewers, and demanding gourmet critics will test your skills.

  • Earn Money & Reputation – Use your earnings to buy ingredient packs, expand your kitchen, and unlock new tools.

  • Rise to Culinary Stardom – Gain enough reputation from food critics, and prestigious gourmet customers will appear, rewarding you with Flame Medals that unlock exclusive upgrades.

Will you master the chaos of the kitchen and turn your restaurant into a five-star success? Sizzle & Stack is easy to learn but packed with depth for those who want to refine their skills and become a legendary chef!
